# Rachel Lynde

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** housewife  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

She has work-hardened hands from years of labor.

_Sources: [v2 c26 P1](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0001)_

## Personality

Rachel is a capable, hardworking, and outspoken woman who prides herself on speaking her mind without fear or favor. She is an energetic community figure and a meddlesome gossip who keeps a sharp eye on everything happening around Avonlea. Despite her critical, opinionated, and nagging tendencies, she is deeply kind, well-meaning, and readily owns up when she makes a mistake. In times of illness, she proves to be a tender, patient, and unwearied caregiver.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P1](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0001), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c31 P7](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0007), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)_

## History

Rachel Lynde lived for decades at Lynde's Hollow in Avonlea, actively running the local Sewing Circle and serving as a key pillar of the Church Aid Society and Foreign Missions Auxiliary. When Marilla Cuthbert decided to adopt a child, Rachel openly voiced her skepticism and later criticized Anne Shirley's looks, prompting a fiery outburst from the girl that temporarily alienated Rachel before she acknowledged Anne's eventual growth and fine character. Over the years, she maintained her intense interest in politics as a staunch Liberal and remained a mainstay of local advice and gossip. When her husband Thomas fell ill, she cared for him with devoted nursing until his death. Facing the necessity of selling her mortgaged farm after his passing, she accepted Marilla's invitation to move into Green Gables so she could remain in Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v1 c18 P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 c18 P41](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0041), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c30 P0](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0000)_
